title: Images don't have a `max-width` in the documentation container
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

Bug

I'm writing a guide and wanted to add a screenshot. The image is 800px wide and overflows in most cases.

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

Images in `.documentation-container` don't have any maximum size.

![localhost\_3002\_v2\_guides\_calendar-widget html ipad pro 1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6137112/35627642-d475502c-0699-11e8-9df5-d620443ba1aa.png)

(rendered as an iPad Pro)

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

![localhost\_3002\_v2\_guides\_calendar-widget html ipad pro](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6137112/35627706-02e77b42-069a-11e8-8a6e-bc446c40f9bc.png)

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**

We should probably set `max-width: 100%;` to images inside `.documentation-container`.

cc @LukyVj probably
